item: A failed feed fetch is recorded in FeedFetchState (field analysis 2026-11, finding 3)
summary: A feed whose own fetch failed wrote no state, so Coverage's error count never filled and exports read a failing feed as never checked. A failure (not a Stop, R614) now records last_checked_at and last_status: the HTTP status the failure names, else 0 (checked, no HTTP status); robots refusals record 0. Validators and the backoff reset unchanged; feed_is_due reads only skip_until. No schema, network or re-processing change.
